name: observe
description: Read current RGB, measured TCP positions, pitch/roll/yaw degrees relative to the downward reference, permissions and budgets without advancing physics. Display floats use at most three decimal places.

name: vla_propose
description: Predict a trajectory without moving. Give one short English sentence describing an immediate action, the observed object and a destination when needed; use task/demo wording and omit reasoning, code and multi-step plans. Example: Move the left gripper above the blue 8. Return a short proposal_id (p1, p2, ...) and TCP samples at steps 5,10,...,50. A new request replaces an unexecuted old proposal.

name: act
description: Accept stored original VLA joint steps, or track model-supplied TCP targets with internal measured-state feedback and IK. TCP targets use continuous gripper_opening (0 closed, 1 open). Supplying targets declines the proposal. Return status, actual native steps, residual errors, current RGB and measured TCP state. Inspect interrupted results before choosing another action; an interrupted VLA proposal cannot be reused. Pose arrival does not verify grasp. Keep reason/assessment concise. Only when observe reports review_due, act.review records legacy checkpoint analysis; it does not determine the native score.

proposal_id.description: Copy the current short VLA proposal_id, e.g. p1; omit when supplying targets.

steps.description: Consecutive prefix length; VLA allows 5..50, default 5.

position.description: Absolute gripping-face-centre TCP XYZ in environment-origin metres.

pitch_deg.description: Degrees about environment +X, relative to the downward reference.

roll_deg.description: Degrees about environment +Y, applied after pitch.

yaw_deg.description: Degrees about environment +Z, applied after roll.

gripper_opening.description: Continuous normalized opening: 0 fully closed, 1 fully open.

position.description: Absolute gripping-face-centre TCP XYZ in environment-origin metres.

pitch_deg.description: Degrees about environment +X, relative to the downward reference.

roll_deg.description: Degrees about environment +Y, applied after pitch.

yaw_deg.description: Degrees about environment +Z, applied after roll.

gripper_opening.description: Continuous normalized opening: 0 fully closed, 1 fully open.

targets.description: Model-chosen dual-arm TCP waypoints; no proposal_id or reject flag. Harness tracks each to 3mm/3deg before advancing. A waypoint may consume multiple native steps; model-side interpolation is unnecessary.

max_native_steps.description: Shared native-step budget for TCP tracking, default 80. Omit for original VLA acceptance.

review.description: Legacy harness checkpoint record, only when observe reports review_due. These fields are not native scoring conditions. Without proposal_id/steps/targets, records the due checkpoint without motion.
